reports.title: Dana Incorporated Reports Strong Third-Quarter Results;

lines: Dana expects to repurchase an additional $100 million of shares in the fourth quarter of 2026.
Dana has revised its full-year guidance, raising its sales outlook by approximately $50 million, reflecting higher demand and recoveries.

2026 Financial Guidance Sales outlook increased $50 million at the midpoint, reflecting stronger commercial vehicle demand and higher commodity recoveries Adjusted EBITDA midpoint maintained at ~$825 million Adjusted free cash flow consistent with last year, as benefits of the Off-Highway divestiture offset the lower earnings due to discontinued operations 2026 Guidance Ranges Sales Outlook Increased;
